newsitem.title: USA: Alternate Postal Q4 boosted by revs, cuts.
newsitem.headline: Alternate Postal Q4 boosted by revs, cuts.

text.p: Alternate Postal Delivery Inc said Friday its recent cuts in overhead and a rebound in revenues versus the third quarter boosted fourth quarter results.

Earlier the company reported earnings of $0.01 a share versus a loss of $0.05 a share last year. Net sales rose to $5.01 million for the quarter, compared with $5.04 million last year and $3.88 million reported for the third quarter.
In Novemeber, Alternate Postal said it planned to make "selected cuts" in overhead to offset an expected decline in magazine revenue.

"The results for the 1996 fourth quarter reflect recent overhead reductions, which should have a continuing effect in the near term, as well as a rebound in revenues from the 1996 third quarter," the company said in a statement.

Alternative Postal also said it entered into an agreement with American Newspaper Network, allowing clients to purchase advertising and transfer copy and graphics to newspapers electronically. It said the service should be available in the second quarter of 1997.
